artifacts.name: FCOA Canonical Memory & Intelligence Fabric Node

capability_deltas: FCOA-Ω is a bidirectional node on the existing CFBE Bible Memory Fabric; it does not create a second memory root.
FCOA consumes portable verified global memory events and current verified projections for cognition, routing and recovery.
FCOA may propose global intelligence updates with source/proof/causal lineage; an FCOA-authored inference cannot self-promote to canonical verified truth.
Accepted FCOA intelligence updates require independent verification and are fanned out to all active registered FUSE receiver systems with digest-bound ACK/convergence tracking.
Newly registered FUSE systems automatically enter the receiver set for subsequent global updates; P2/P3/P4 private raw content remains domain-local.

llm_context.external_effect_rule: Memory state and intelligence updates never inherit provider/external effect authority.

route_deltas: Before substantial FCOA reasoning, consume fresh verified FUSE update/current-memory context where available.
Every material FCOA learning/update is compiled with source refs, proof refs, causal parents, idempotency identity and privacy/truth class.
Unverified FCOA outputs remain DERIVED_INTERPRETATION and are not broadcast as canonical truth.
Independent ACCEPT verification promotes an update to DERIVED_VERIFIED; only then may global receiver fanout begin.
Global fanout targets all active registered FUSE systems dynamically and tracks per-receiver digest-bound ACKs until converged.
Memory/fanout failure does not rewrite immutable event truth and does not grant external-effect authority.
summary: Bind FCOA-Ω into the canonical CFBE Bible Memory and intelligence fabric as a bidirectional verified consumer/producer with global receiver fanout and convergence tracking.
warnings: FCOA is not a second memory root; immutable event truth and existing canonical fabric controls remain authoritative.
FCOA cannot self-verify its own intelligence proposal into canonical truth.
Global memory carries minimum necessary portable metadata/pointers; sensitive raw content remains domain-local.
Memory state never grants provider credentials, external messaging/publication, spending, IAM or destructive-effect authority.
